cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy: Cílem předmětu je seznámit studenty s užitnými vlastnostmi traktorů a automobilů. Podat přehled o konstrukci traktorů a automobilů. Jedná se o přenes výkonu motoru až na hnací kola nebo pásy. Vliv podvozků na limitní zatížení náprav, terramechanika a mezní měrný tlak na půdu. Podat ucelený přehled o konstrukci a funkci jednotlivých dílčích uzlů vozidel. Předmět seznamuje studenty o ztrátách a účinnostech silové a výkonové bilance přenosu energie, se zaměření na ekonomiku jejich provozu. en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Course objective and learning outcomes: The aim of the course is to get students acquainted with the technical properties of tractors and vehicles. To bring an overview of the construction of tractors and types of vehicles. To explain transmission of engine power to the drive wheels or tracks. To analyze an influence of chassis on axle load, terramechanics and soil specific pressure limit. To provide a comprehensive overview of the construction and function of individual subassemblies of vehicles. The course introduces students to efficiencies of the power transmission as well as to power balance, with a focus on the economics of their operation. Subject content: Students get acquainted with technical properties of mobile energy means, gather abilities to evaluate the efficiency of engine power transfer to individual functional assemblies of the machine. It brins an overview of a function of the power transmission systems from the engine to the drive wheels, as well as the construction of chassis, steering mechanisms, electrical accessories, brake and hydraulic systems used on tractors, trucks and self-propelled agricultural machines. It introduces students to current ergonomic requirements for the operation of mobile technical means. It allows students to gain comprehensive knowledge about the driving and traction characteristics of tractors and vehicles. Based on the acquired knowledge, it enables alumni to evaluate traction properties of vehicles in operation.
